shots.actions: the identity plate and the enemy chief emblem are hung on the steel gate post, only these two metal pieces hang there and nothing else is on the post; the post reads as outline only in the grey fog; the pattern on the metal is abstract geometry with no readable emblem
shots.layout_and_occlusion: 6 visible instances. Dominant SteelGatePost covers 41x100 percent at frame 46/50. Left to right: SteelGatePost, StreetGround, ThresholdStone, IdentityPlate, EnemyChiefEmblem.
shots.lighting_spatial_logic: one cold overhead key over the steel table with shadow detail retained instead of crushed black, cold grey bounce from concrete and steel, the emergency lamps on the gate posts, the residual fire heads, the twin flame and the derrick lamp as the only moving light sources, and the grey fog pressing down over the street with the unlit crossing kept dark
